identity: public pretrained model, adapted diagnostic comparison; not same-fold retraining or clean outer validation
selection: Fixed public synthesis50000/expression5000 weights; no fitting, checkpoint selection or output-based tuning

timeline.lanes: minimum nonoverlapping lanes, stable onset/source-index order; no clipping/deletion
timeline.context: whole voice, official bidirectional encoding and recurrent synthesis; no resets or chunks
timeline.velocity: unused as in official expression inputs
timeline.mixing: float32 unit gain addition in lane-index order; no normalization, limiting, posthoc gating or alignment search

randomness.rule: Set NumPy and TF seeds after model/weight loading, before expression generation; no reseeding within voice

audio.reverb: official instrument-specific trained48000-sample reverb; inference decay start16000 exponent4; original final-audio path

RMS.length: exact target prefix after coverage check; full waveform saved

execution.failure: Pause on any worker failure; no automatic restart or migration

reporting.metrics: Frozen supplement/common.py metrics, all domains/min-note lengths/log floors/time scales
reporting.coverage: All186 IDs accounted; failed outputs explicitly listed, never silently excluded; metric None denominators reported
reporting.paired_bootstrap: same5000 group resamples and seed20260911 as supplement/report.py, common defined tracks per metric
sensitivities: target-hash dedup using lexicographic track representative
annotation-native single-lane subset, fixed before scores
reporting.interpretation: descriptive cross-system diagnostic; different training data/tasks; no SOTA/clean generalization/efficiency claim; historical researcher selection persists
